# Compatibility entry point for PaaS hosts (Runflare, Hugging Face Spaces, …)
# and Docker builds that auto-install requirements.txt.
#
# The real dependency set is fully pinned (versions + SHA-256 hashes) in
# requirements.lock. Do not edit that file by hand; regenerate both locks from
# pyproject.toml whenever dependencies change:
#
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --universal --python-version 3.10 \
#       --generate-hashes -o requirements.lock
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --universal --python-version 3.10 \
#       --generate-hashes -o requirements-dev.lock
-r requirements.lock
